payload.summary: Record what the 2026-09-17 external audit got wrong, so a seventh audit does not re-report it
payload.detail: An external audit of psychiatry.tools was checked finding by finding against origin/main on 2026-09-17 (PR #2860). It audited a5c3c42b6, THIRTY-ONE COMMITS BEHIND main, which is most of why. Recording the refutations because five of them were already answered by work in this repository, and the cost of re-deriving each one was hours. REFUTED, WITH THE EVIDENCE. (1) ANSWER AND DOCUMENTS HANGS (its L1, L2, and its number-one recommendation): already root-caused and fixed by PR #2849 and PR #2855 on 2026-09-16/17. read_site_content_public_records re-hashed the whole 9.5 MB frozen corpus on every public read, measured on the live database at mean 8,656 ms / max 17,263 ms. See docs/audit/2026-09-16-catalogue-read-latency.md. (2) SEARCH-SCOPE TENANCY (its C3 and hypothesis H1, reported as a live hole): the database forbids it. documents_ownerless_requires_publication_marker, added and VALIDATED on 2026-09-02, requires every ownerless row to carry public_corpus or sit in status='failed' quarantine, and resolveSearchScope already filters status='indexed'. The predicates differ in text and agree in force. #ZBAC9D is the id of the change that CLOSED this, not an open finding. (3) SAFETY-CHIP NUMERIC TRUNCATION (part of C4): fixed twice since L111, pinned by two committed tests. (4) RAILWAY WEBHOOK SECRET NOT TIMING-SAFE (part of C11): it IS timing-safe, with a byte-length gate first, and a header is checked BEFORE the query token. (5) AUTH CALLBACK OPEN REDIRECT VIA BACKSLASH (H2, part of C12): not exploitable. origin is concatenated ahead of the path, so the host is fixed before the parser sees it - measured, with /\evil.com, /\/evil.com, /..//evil.com and a CRLF payload all resolving to our own origin. IdP errors go to a query parameter rendered as a React text node, never HTML. (6) CLAIM-SUPPORT CAN STILL REPORT high (part of C7): it cannot. Every exit from assessAndEnforceClaimSupport caps high (rag-claim-support.ts:1325, :1430). (7) RETAINED-COPY NOTICE (L5): that is the notice working as designed; the real gap is surfaces that fall back WITHOUT showing it, already open as #V98SPY, #8GB18R and #3PW9TY. (8) DIFFERENTIALS PROMPT CHIP (L8): every quick-action chip in every mode fills the box and waits for submit (master-search-header.tsx:746-920). REAL BUT ALREADY DECIDED, do not reverse: its C8 (VerificationNotice hidden on source-only answers) is ledger #227 over #207, owner decision 2026-08-03; its C10 (empty list reads audited as allowed) is deliberate and test-pinned; its C11 residual is a Railway constraint, not a code choice; its T1 is open as P1 #2M4PX1. STILL OPEN AND WORTH A HUMAN: whether the live site is actually fast again, and whether CARING_CONTACTS_DEMO_ENABLED is set in production - both blocked by network policy from the session that did this work.
